controles.affirmation: Le chiffre d'affaires Scores B2B a progresse de 41,5% sur un an au T3 FY2026, porte par une hausse de 131,6 M$ liee aux scores d'origination hypothecaire
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026 : 'Revenues for our Scores segment were $458.9 million during the quarter ended June 30, 2026, a 41% increase' ; 'Scores segment revenues increased $134.6 million due to an increase of $131.6 million in our business-to-business scores revenue and an increase of $3.0 million in our business-to-consumer scores revenue'. kpis-haut FICO : scores_b2b_rev 400,04 M$, +49,0%.
controles.correction_proposee: Le +41,5% est la croissance du SEGMENT Scores dans son ensemble (458,9 M$ contre 324,3 M$), pas celle du B2B. Le chiffre d'affaires Scores B2B a progresse de 49,0% (400,0 M$ contre 268,4 M$). Corriger le taux ou l'agregat.

controles.affirmation: Hook : FICO a double sa dette a 5,6 Mds $ en neuf mois
controles.verbatim_source: Total debt balance was $5.6 billion as of June 30, 2026, compared with $3.1 billion as of September 30, 2025.
controles.correction_proposee: La dette est passee de 3,1 a 5,6 Mds $, soit +81% : ce n'est pas un doublement. Ecrire 'a augmente de 81%' ou 'de 3,1 a 5,6 Mds $'.

controles.affirmation: Hook : le regulateur federal du logement a mis fin en juillet 2025 au monopole de fait du FICO Score dans le credit hypothecaire
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : 'the change announced by the FHFA Director in July 2025 permitting mortgage originators to choose the credit score they submit with mortgages delivered to Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac' ; le meme facteur de risque precise que les GSE imposent toujours 'a requirement by those enterprises that U.S. lenders provide FICO Scores for each mortgage delivered to them'
controles.correction_proposee: Le document decrit un changement PERMETTANT aux organismes de credit de choisir le score qu'ils transmettent, pas la suppression d'une exigence. Ecrire : 'la FHFA a ouvert en juillet 2025 la possibilite pour les organismes de credit hypothecaire de choisir le score qu'ils transmettent a Fannie Mae et Freddie Mac'. Supprimer 'a mis fin au monopole de fait' et 'choisir librement'.

controles.affirmation: Le 10-K evoque un futur changement permettant l'usage de scores provenant de moins de trois agences
controles.verbatim_source: 'or a potential future change permitting mortgage originators to underwrite loans using credit scores from fewer than three national consumer reporting agencies'

controles.affirmation: Plainte antitrust : le 24 novembre 2024 le tribunal a rejete la majorite des demandes mais a autorise une demande section 2 du Sherman Act et des demandes de droit d'Etat a passer en discovery ; FICO entend se defendre vigoureusement
controles.verbatim_source: 'FICO is a defendant in consolidated putative class action lawsuits brought in the Northern District of Illinois against FICO and the credit bureaus, Equifax, Experian and TransUnion, alleging antitrust claims in connection with the distribution of FICO Scores. On November 24, 2024, the court ruled ... The court dismissed with prejudice all claims in the lawsuit other than a Sherman Act Section 2 claim and accompanying state law claims against FICO, which were allowed to proceed through the discovery stage of the litigation. FICO intends to vigorously defend against the remaining claims in this proceeding.'
controles.correction_proposee: Formulation en fait prudente : le tribunal a rejete AVEC PREJUDICE toutes les autres demandes, pas seulement 'la majorite'.

controles.affirmation: Capitaux propres negatifs de 4 097 M$ au 30 juin 2026 contre -1 746 M$ neuf mois plus tot ; tresorerie 248,4 M$
controles.verbatim_source: Bilan 10-Q T3 FY2026 : total stockholders' deficit (4,097,135) vs (1,745,784) ; Cash and cash equivalents 248,444 (milliers de dollars)

controles.affirmation: En juin 2026, FICO a leve un pret a terme de 1,5 Md $ pour financer un ASR ; rachats du seul dernier trimestre a 2,3 Mds $
controles.verbatim_source: 'In June 2026, we amended our credit agreement to provide for a $1.5 billion term loan, the proceeds of which were used to fund an accelerated share repurchase agreement (ASR Agreement)' ; 'Total share repurchases during the quarter ended June 30, 2026 were $2.3 billion, compared with $511.3 million during the quarter ended June 30, 2025'

controles.affirmation: Flux de tresorerie disponible trimestriel de 379,6 M$ ; dette long terme 5,58 Mds $ (+100,7%) ; charges d'interets nettes 59,9 M$ (+82,0%)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T3 FY2026 : 'Interest expense, net (59,877) (32,899)' soit +82,0%. Le FCF trimestriel (379,58 M$) et la dette LT (+100,7% sur un an) proviennent de kpis-haut FICO ; le 10-Q publie l'OCF cumule 9 mois (777,9 M$ contre 555,1 M$).
controles.correction_proposee: Attention a la coherence : le hook parle d'un doublement de la dette 'en neuf mois' (+81%, 3,1 -> 5,6 Mds $) tandis que le quantitatif parle de +100,7% ; ces deux taux ne portent pas sur la meme periode (neuf mois contre douze mois). Preciser.

controles.verbatim_source: 'Total revenues were $674.2 million during the quarter ended June 30, 2026, a 26% increase' ; 'Scores segment operating income as a percentage of segment revenue increased to 91% from 88%' (le 10-Q arrondit a 91%, coherent avec 90,8% calcule)

controles.affirmation: Experian, TransUnion et Equifax representent 51% du CA total en 2025, 45% en 2024, 41% en 2023 ; le secteur bancaire 92% des revenus FY2025 ; ces trois agences codetiennent VantageScore
controles.verbatim_source: 'revenues generated from our agreements with Experian, TransUnion and Equifax collectively accounted for 51%, 45% and 41% of our total revenues, respectively' ; 'Our largest market segment is financial services, representing 92% of our total revenue during fiscal 2025' ; 'VantageScore (a joint venture entity established by the three major U.S. consumer reporting agencies), which is selling a credit scoring product competitive with our products'
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-K dit 'financial services' (services financiers), pas 'secteur bancaire' : elargir le terme.

controles.affirmation: Hausse B2B attribuee 'primarily' au prix unitaire sur le trimestre, au prix ET au volume sur neuf mois
controles.verbatim_source: Trimestre : 'The increase in business-to-business scores revenue was primarily attributable to a higher mortgage origination scores unit price.' Neuf mois : 'The increase in business-to-business scores revenue was primarily attributable to both a higher unit price and an increase in volume of mortgage origination scores.'
